general_identity: For rank R>=2 choose r0=r1=R, one R-by-R determinant at s0, N height1 columns at s0, i height1 at s1. T={0}; F=p^-i h^i Z_(0,1,1)^(N+1-pi) product_{j=2..R} Z_(0,j,j). Selected diagonal X-monomial coefficient J_F=(N+1)! i! /p^i. Delta_R=ell(N)^2+R ell(N)+R^2(ell(R)+ell(i)), d_Q=N+R+i, and positive-sum part same as 1x1. Comparing previous rank1 no-tall-column result: B_R=B_1-(Delta_R-Delta_1)+R/(p^2-1) < B_1, since Delta_R-Delta_1=(R-1)ell(N)+R^2 ell(R)+(R^2-1)ell(i)>R/(p^2-1). Thus v_p(J_F)>B_R universally for all odd primes p, k>=1, i<=p^(k-1), R>=2. This is a single selected diagonal coefficient for a determinant of arbitrary rank; it does NOT certify arbitrary matrix coefficients or source-global theta membership.
